content_sections.heading: Reservation Category-wise Vacancy Break-up
content_sections.text: Based on the AWT/AWH vacancy list released along with the notification, the 62 Anganwadi Teacher posts are distributed across reservation categories as follows:

content_sections.heading: Full Anganwadi Centre-wise Vacancy List
content_sections.text: The table below lists all 62 Anganwadi Centres (AWCs) with vacancies, as per the official vacancy annexure. Each row shows the reservation category the post is earmarked for. Note: As per the vacancy annexure, the "From Date" and "To Date" listed against each Anganwadi Centre (27.07.2026 to 05.08.2026) correspond to the application/verification window and are the same across all 62 posts.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The applicant shall have passed Intermediate (10+2). The candidate shall be 18 years to 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026. Only women candidates are eligible to apply. The candidate must be a local resident of the concerned Anganwadi Centre area for which she applies. In rural areas, she must be a resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat. In urban areas, she must be a resident of the concerned Municipal Ward (GHMC/MMC/CMC). For Anganwadi Teacher posts reserved under the SC/ST Sub-Plan, only eligible SC/ST women candidates belonging to the same Hamlet/Habitation concerned are eligible. A Residence Certificate issued by the Tahsildar is mandatory, and only certificates issued within one year from the date of this notification will be accepted. Candidates belonging to the Community/Category specified against the respective Roster Point are eligible to apply. If there is any change in the candidate's name, it must be supported by a Gazette Notification or a Court Order - only such cases will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs)
content_sections.text: The following categories of women candidates with disabilities are also eligible to apply, provided they are capable of performing the duties of an Anganwadi Teacher: Candidates with hearing impairment who can hear with the assistance of hearing aids. Candidates with visual impairment/blindness who can independently perform their duties without the assistance of an escort. Candidates with locomotor disability affecting the upper or lower limbs, provided they are capable of imparting pre-school education and caring for children without difficulty.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (Scanned Copies to be Uploaded)
content_sections.text: SSC Certificate (Proof of Date of Birth) Community Certificate issued by the Tahsildar Intermediate Marks Memo/Pass Certificate Residence Certificate issued by the Tahsildar (issued within one year from the date of Notification) SADAREM Disability Certificate (where applicable) Husband's Death Certificate (for Widow candidates) Orphan Certificate issued by the Tahsildar (where applicable) Voter Identity Card Aadhaar Card

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online
content_sections.text: Visit the official Department website: http://wdcw.tg.nic.in. Submit the application only through the Online Application Web Portal between 27.07.2026 (10:30 AM) and 05.08.2026 (5:00 PM). Fill in details and upload all required scanned documents listed above. After submitting online, carry all relevant certificates along with 2 sets of Gazetted Officer-attested photocopies to the concerned ICDS Project Office (Alwal, Medchal, or Quthbullapur, as applicable) for certificate verification, between 27.07.2026 (10:30 AM) and 05.08.2026 (5:00 PM), during office working hours.

content_sections.heading: Certificate Verification
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit all relevant certificates along with Gazetted Officer-attested photocopies (2 sets/Xerox) at the concerned ICDS Project Office - i.e., ICDS Alwal, Medchal, or Quthbullapur - from 27.07.2026 (10:30 AM) to 05.08.2026 (5:00 PM), during office working hours. Applications with pending or unsubmitted certificate verification will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Modes of Application NOT Accepted
content_sections.text: Applications submitted through Post, E-mail, Prajavani, or manual applications submitted directly at the CDPO Office or the Office of the District Welfare Officer will not be considered under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify a written exam, interview, or a detailed selection procedure. It confirms only that candidates are selected against reservation Roster Points specific to each Anganwadi Centre, subject to local candidature and eligibility/document verification. Any additional selection process detail is not mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The District Collector & Chairperson, District Selection Committee, Medchal-Malkajgiri District, reserves the right to cancel, modify, or amend this notification, either wholly or partly, at any stage without assigning any reason. Candidates shall apply only through the Online Application Web Portal: http://wdcw.tg.nic.in. Only applications submitted online will be considered. Applications submitted through Post, E-mail, Prajavani, or manual submission at CDPO/DWO offices will not be considered. Persons with visual impairment who require assistance to use the internet may seek help; escort assistance is also permitted for online application submission where needed, per the notification's general guidance for PwD applicants.

faq.question: Q1. How many Anganwadi Teacher vacancies are there in Medchal-Malkajgiri District in 2026?
faq.answer: There are 62 Anganwadi Teacher vacancies in total, distributed across three ICDS Projects: Alwal (18), Medchal (20), and Quthbullapur (24).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Medchal-Malkajgiri Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closing date is 05.08.2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Anganwadi Teacher post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
Q5. Can male candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the notification invites applications only from eligible women candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I apply for this Anganwadi Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only online at http://wdcw.tg.nic.in. Applications sent by Post, E-mail, or Prajavani, or submitted manually at CDPO/DWO offices, will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required to apply?
faq.answer: SSC Certificate, Community Certificate, Intermediate Marks Memo/Pass Certificate, Residence Certificate, SADAREM Disability Certificate (if applicable), Husband's Death Certificate (for widows), Orphan Certificate (if applicable), Voter ID, and Aadhaar Card.
